LanguageData.DeadSarlacc.label: dead sarlacc
LanguageData.DeadSarlacc.description: The remnant of a dead sarlacc creature. Perhaps disease, starvation, predation from burrowing insects or maybe even old age has killed it leaving behind a cavern that it's body once filled.

LanguageData.DeadSarlacc.comps.CompSealable.sealComma: Choose a colonist to permanently collapse the sarlacc cavity entrance. Anything or anyone left below will be lost forever.
LanguageData.DeadSarlacc.portal.enteredLetterText: In the depths of a dead Sarlacc. Not much here but rocks and rubble and dead flesh. Quite the morbid tourist attraction!
LanguageData.SarlaccPit.label: sarlacc pit
LanguageData.SarlaccPit.description: The gaping maw of a juvenile sarlacc creature. The endlessly hungry sarlacc can be used to quickly get rid of various organic corpses and so such sites are popular with various criminal enterprises. It will occasionally regurgitate a small amount indigestible scrap metal; no doubt leftover from some unlucky "prey".
